authentication: useEffect(()=>{let active=true;let request=0;const loadProfile=async(session:Session|null)=>{const currentRequest=++request;if(!session){setProfile(null);setAuthError('');setAuthLoading(false);return;}setAuthLoading(true);setAuthError('');try{const {data,error}=await supabase.from('profiles').select('role, customer_id').eq('user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!active||currentRequest!==request)return;if(error){setProfile(null);setAuthError(`Unable to load your profile: ${error.message}`);setAuthLoading(false);return;}if(!data){setProfile(null);setAuthError('No profile is configured for this account.');setAuthLoading(false);return;}if(!isRole(data.role)){setProfile(null);setAuthError('Your profile has an unsupported role.');setAuthLoading(false);return;}setProfile({userId:session.user.id,email:session.user.email??'',role:data.role,customerId:data.customer_id??null});setAuthLoading(false);}catch(error){if(!active||currentRequest!==request)return;setProfile(null);setAuthError(error instanceof Error?`Unable to load your profile: ${error.message}`:'Unable to load your profile.');setAuthLoading(false);}};const {data:{subscription}}=supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event,session)=>{window.setTimeout(()=>{if(active)void loadProfile(session);},0);});void supabase.auth.getSession().then(({data,error})=>{if(!active)return;if(error){setAuthError(`Unable to restore your session: ${error.message}`);setAuthLoading(false);return;}void loadProfile(data.session);}).catch(error=>{if(!active)return;setAuthError(error instanceof Error?`Unable to restore your session: ${error.message}`:'Unable to restore your session.');setAuthLoading(false);});return()=>{active=false;request++;subscription.unsubscribe();};},[]);
